title: Remember November 2026 Is Coming
claim: The meme is an AI polar-bear video set to Oliver Tree's 'Life Goes On', popularized on Instagram Reels and TikTok in September 2026.
excerpt: Search summary: the polar bear sings 'Remember November 2026 is coming' as a reminder of the 2023 meme; popularized on Reels/TikTok in Sept 2026; 'Know Your Meme recorded more than 980,000 views within two weeks' (unclear what was counted); original 2023 post dated March 27, 2023 by @gmd_arahis.
